One project record, office to field

Most jobs still run on five apps, a spreadsheet and a group text.

Plans live in one place, the takeoff in another, the deal math on a napkin and the permit status in somebody's head. Truscale keeps all of it on one project.

Counting off a PDF by hand

Upload the plan set. The AI Plan Reader pulls dimensions, rooms and schedules from the sheets and flags what does not match. Your estimator checks the numbers before anything goes out.

Field measurements on the back of a receipt

Scan the house with a Pro iPhone or iPad, or use a photo and a scale card on any other phone. A tape check on one wall confirms the scan before anything is ordered.

A deal that looked good until month twelve

The Deal Analyzer shows profit, max offer and risk flags with a GO or NO-GO. Material costs are forecast at 6, 9 and 12 months, plus a 14 month worst case.

A sub on site with no insurance on file

Permits and certificates of insurance are tracked on every project. A purchase order does not release until the permit is issued and the vendor certificate is current.

Plan, estimate, decide, build.

The same project moves through four stages. Each one picks up what the last one finished, so nobody types the same house twice.

PlanPlans, measuring, drawings EstimateTakeoff and forecasts DecideDeal, structure, site, finishes BuildPermits, POs, schedule, closeout
Stage 1

Plan: get the house into the system right.

Start from a plan set, a phone scan or a blank lot.

  • AI Plan Reader. Reads dimensions, rooms and schedules, cross-checks dates and revisions between sheets, and an estimator verifies.
  • Floor plans with dimensions and a 3D model built from them.
  • Construction sheets A, M, P, E and S, with title blocks and schedules.
Stage 2

Estimate: every material, from a screw to the roof.

  • Whole-house takeoff where every line traces back to a zone on the plan.
  • Color-coded markup PDFs so the team sees what was counted and what was left out.
  • Excel export for your supplier or your own pricing sheet.
  • Cost forecasts at 6, 9 and 12 months, plus a 14 month worst case.
Stage 3

Decide: know if the deal works before you buy.

  • Deal Analyzer for new builds, flips, remodels, additions and build-to-rent: comps and ARV, area trend score, profit, max offer, risk flags, GO or NO-GO.
  • Structure check and expansion options. Foundation, framing and rafters pass or fail, and ways to make the house bigger with a zoning check.
  • Site: zoning clearance, sun hours, which way the house faces, parcel number lookup.
  • Finish selections in 3D with Good, Better and Best costs and client approval.
Stage 4

Build: nothing moves until the paperwork is clear.

  • Permits and insurance tracked on every project, with hard gates.
  • POs to vendors with start notices.
  • Calendar with late and running-behind alerts.
  • Daily logs, punch lists, job costing and closeout.

Who it is for

Small and mid-size teams that build, remodel or invest in houses in North Texas.

Home builders

Spec and custom homes, and production lots. Keep plans, takeoffs, permits, POs and the schedule on one record per lot.

Start withPlan Reader, takeoff, permit and insurance gates

Flippers and investors

Run the numbers on a property before you make an offer, and see what happens to profit if the job runs long.

Developers

Measure a house without a laser.

Use the phone already in your pocket. The app picks the method your phone supports.

PhoneHow it measuresWhat you do
Pro iPhone or iPad LiDAR scan of each room Walk the room slowly with the camera on the walls.
Other iPhones and Android phones Photo plus a printed scale card Set the card against the wall and take the photo square on.
Any phone Tape check Tape one wall and enter it. If the scan is off by more than the tolerance, the app asks for a new scan before anything is ordered.

Your crew can run it in Spanish.

The app works in English and Spanish. Each person picks a language, and the project stays the same for everyone, so the office and the crew look at the same job.

Free tools you can use today

No sign-up. They run in your browser and nothing you type leaves your device.

Flip and build deal calculator

Profit, margin, max offer by the 70% rule and at your target margin, with a GO, CAUTION or NO-GO.

Which way does my house face?

Use your phone compass or a dial to get the facing, the backyard direction and a Texas sun note.

Joist and rafter span check

Bending, shear and deflection for common lumber sizes. A quick reference, not a design.
